title: The Best Christmas Ever with Dana Gillespie & The London Blues Band
summary: Dana Gillespie’s Christmas party at TAM, opening with the Golden Hour: the first hour of the night belongs to the juniors.

programme.title: The Golden Hour
programme.text: The night opens with TAM’s juniors: young singers and players from the TAM Academy and the Junior & Youth Open Mic take the stage, in front of a full Christmas crowd.

programme.title: Dana Gillespie & The London Blues Band
programme.text: Dana and the band bring the blues home for Christmas, in the tradition of Dana’s Christmas nights at TAM.

tiers.name: Final week

highlights.title: Sixty years of music, live in one room
highlights.text: Dana made her first record, “Thank You Boy”, in 1965 as a teenager, with Jimmy Page producing. Since then she has been involved in recording more than 70 albums, moving from 60s pop through 70s glam and rock to the blues.

highlights.title: The song David Bowie wrote for her
highlights.text: Bowie wrote “Andy Warhol” for Dana, and with Mick Ronson he produced her 1973 album Weren’t Born a Man. She also sings backing vocals on “It Ain’t Easy” on Ziggy Stardust.
links: Dana’s Andy Warhol night at TAM

highlights.title: The West End’s first Mary Magdalene
highlights.text: In 1972 Dana played Mary Magdalene in the first London production of Jesus Christ Superstar at the Palace Theatre, and she sings on the original London cast album.

highlights.title: A blues singer the world books
highlights.text: Dana sang with Austria’s Mojo Blues Band in the 1980s and organises the Mustique Blues Festival in the Caribbean. In 2023 she and The London Blues Band were featured artists at SXSW in Austin, Texas, playing The Continental Club. In 2024 she reached the final of Una Voce per San Marino, the Eurovision selection.

highlights.title: The London Blues Band
highlights.text: Dana’s band brings together musicians from TAM’s own stage, including boogie-woogie pianist and harmonica player Dino Baptiste and bassist Harry Whitty, who studied at the Royal Academy of Music.

highlights.title: Her life, told with no regrets
highlights.text: Dana’s 2021 memoir Weren’t Born a Man was called “eye-popping” by The Spectator and “hilarious and moving” by The Times.

highlights.title: A TAM Christmas tradition
highlights.text: Dana has played a Christmas night at TAM since 2021, from Dana & Dino’s Christmas Stuffing to last year’s Best Christmas Party Ever. This year the night opens with the juniors’ Golden Hour.
